study_scope: Distinct SECONDARY botanical-description comparative study, not the already-frozen independent direct-primary-source organ-K replication
motivating_prior: Original AusTraits post-outcome organ grouping showed seed/fruit vs vegetative higher K ~77-79%; this new source/trait-class hypothesis is a follow-up, not an independent preregistered discovery

pre_outcome_trait_mapping.fruit_excluded: NHM lacks comparable continuous fruit dimension columns. Never reclassify fruit shape/type/colour as size.

phenotype_semantics: Each cell is an OCR-extracted maximum described species dimension; these are NOT organismal individual means. Never equate source source to direct primary measurement; ambiguous ranges, heights vs widths, leaf versus leaflet identity remain threats.

provisional_estimands_if_and_only_if_pre.primary: Within each of the two primary floras, in each tree treatment separately, equal-family mean fraction of same-species same-tree seed_length K > leaf_length K; separately seed_width versus leaf_width. Each family counts once after averaging eligible pairs; report pair-weighted descriptives as secondary.
provisional_estimands_if_and_only_if_pre.uncertainty: 5,000 complete-family bootstrap draws per source and tree; no pairwise-independent Bernoulli CI
provisional_estimands_if_and_only_if_pre.transfer: Qualitative direction across fixed China and North America source strata; never infer two independent evolutionary origins merely from distinct flora datasets.
provisional_estimands_if_and_only_if_pre.null_requirement: Do not infer organ-specific evolutionary rates, stabilizing selection or OU alpha without a separately prequalified observed-tree evolutionary+source-noise null.
provisional_estimands_if_and_only_if_pre.classification: Only call directional descriptive consistency when both sources and both trees have >0.5 equal-family reproductive-higher rate and 95% family bootstrap lower bounds >0.5. Otherwise mixed/insufficient; not an evolutionary null test.
provisional_estimands_if_and_only_if_pre.negative_classification: If no sources pass frozen two-tree support, HOLD without K. If source-specific direction differs, report disagreement without changing source, species or trait filters.

hard_nonclaims: The original external primary-measurement replication remains HOLD; this secondary described-species morphology cohort cannot validate it.
A taxonomic flora description is not a new primary species measurement; different floras may share source descriptions.
Maxima of two morphological dimensions may differ in source measurement quality; no inference of intrinsic K or evolutionary rate.
No evolutionary selection, adaptive optimum, developmental constraint or phylogenetic memory half-life conclusion from K sign alone.
